title: Half-Bridge Converter (Isolated)
description: Isolated half-bridge converter: capacitive input divider, two NMOS switches with complementary floating gate drives, 1:1 coupled-inductor transformer with primary RC snubber, and a full-wave rectifier into an LC filter. Steps 48 V down to roughly 7.9 V (D=0.2 per switch, fsw=100 kHz). Authored clean-room with qspice-mcp tools and validated end-to-end.
